# n-slideshow

> Carousel slideshow with snap scrolling, autoplay, controls, and indicators.

**Class:** `NSlideshow`

**ARIA role:** `region`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `direction` | `string` |  | Scroll direction: "horizontal" | "vertical" |
| `controls` | `boolean` |  | Shows prev/next navigation buttons |
| `indicators` | `boolean` |  | Shows dot indicators |
| `autoplay` | `boolean` |  | Enables automatic slide advancement |
| `interval` | `number` |  | Autoplay interval in milliseconds (default 5000) |
| `loop` | `boolean` |  | Enables infinite looping |
| `peek` | `boolean` |  | Shows partial adjacent slides |
| `per-view` | `number` |  | Number of slides visible at once |
| `gap` | `string` |  | Gap between slides |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables keyboard navigation |
| `index` | `number` |  | Active slide index (0-based) |

## CSS Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Values | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|-------------|
| `part` | enum | `controls`, `indicators`, `next`, `prev`, `track` | Targets internal structural parts (track, controls, indicators) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `native:slide-change` | _(none)_ | Fired when the active slide changes with `{ index, slide }` detail |

## CSS Custom Properties

| Token | Default | Purpose |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `--n-border-hover` |  | Border color on hover |
| `--n-border-muted` |  | Muted border color |
| `--n-duration` |  | Transition duration |
| `--n-easing` |  | Transition easing |
| `--n-focus-ring` |  | Focus ring style |
| `--n-ink` |  | Ink (text) color |
| `--n-ink-hover` |  | Ink on hover |
| `--n-panel` |  | Panel background color |
| `--n-panel-hover` |  | Panel background on hover |
| `--n-per-view` | `1` | Number of slides visible at once |
| `--n-radius` |  | Border radius |
| `--n-shadow-sm` |  | Small shadow for control buttons |
| `--n-size` |  | Component height |
| `--n-slideshow-gap` | `calc(var(--n-space) * 4)` | Gap between items |
| `--n-slideshow-peek` | `calc(var(--n-space-k) * var(--n-space) * 2)` | Amount of adjacent slide visible when peek is enabled |
| `--n-space` |  | Block/gap spacing |
| `--n-space-k` |  | Inline padding multiplier |

## Accessibility

- **Role:** `region`

### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `Home` | Navigates to the first slide |
| `End` | Navigates to the last slide |
| `ArrowLeft` | Navigates to the previous slide |
| `ArrowRight` | Navigates to the next slide |

## Behavior

- **scroll snap** → Detects active slide and fires native:slide-change
- **autoplay** → Advances slides at interval milliseconds

## Composition

### Children
- `<n-slide>`

## Usage

### Minimal

```html
<n-slideshow></n-slideshow>
```

### Examples

```html
<n-slideshow>
        <n-slide><div class="slide-content slide-1">1</div></n-slide>
        <n-slide><div class="slide-content slide-2">2</div></n-slide>
        <n-slide><div class="slide-content slide-3">3</div></n-slide>
      </n-slideshow>
```

```html
<n-slideshow controls indicators>
        <n-slide><div class="slide-content slide-1">Slide 1</div></n-slide>
        <n-slide><div class="slide-content slide-2">Slide 2</div></n-slide>
        <n-slide><div class="slide-content slide-3">Slide 3</div></n-slide>
        <n-slide><div class="slide-content slide-4">Slide 4</div></n-slide>
      </n-slideshow>
```

```html
<n-slideshow controls indicators autoplay interval="3000" loop>
        <n-slide><div class="slide-content slide-1">A</div></n-slide>
        <n-slide><div class="slide-content slide-2">B</div></n-slide>
        <n-slide><div class="slide-content slide-3">C</div></n-slide>
      </n-slideshow>
```
